notes:
Japanese cards and sets now read entirely in English.

- Every Japanese card carries an English name (harvested from TCG Collector), and
  the set list, search, card modal, picker, set detail and scan review display
  English only — no Japanese alongside. Only the ~195 PCG7-9 cards (no TCG
  Collector page) fall back to their printed name.
- Set and series headers use curated English names, covering all 118 sets and
  11 series.

No scan-index rebuild is required: names are not fingerprinted.
